# Strikethrough

> Strikethrough (strikethrough.com.au) is an independent Australian deal checker. It checks advertised deals from Australian retailers against the same product at other stores and against price history, and gives each deal a verdict (such as Record low, Best price tracked, Lower elsewhere or Was-price unconfirmed) and a score out of 100. It is run by Cameron Gibbens and is not paid by retailers.

## Key pages
- [Home: today's checked deals](https://strikethrough.com.au/): all tracked deals with verdicts, Today's best 3, a discount map by retailer and category, watch-outs and sale dates.
- [Method](https://strikethrough.com.au/method/): where prices come from, how verdicts are decided, and their limits.
- [Category pages](https://strikethrough.com.au/sitemap.xml): one page per category at /deals/<category>/ listing checked deals.
- [Price-check pages](https://strikethrough.com.au/sitemap.xml): one page per product at /price/<product>/ comparing every store we track, with price history notes.
- [Contact and corrections](https://strikethrough.com.au/contact/): hello@strikethrough.com.au

## Data
- [Current deals as JSON](https://strikethrough.com.au/data/deals.json): every tracked deal with retailer, price, was-price, real discount, verdict, score, reason, source and date checked.

## Notes for citing
- Prices are snapshots from the date shown on each page. Always confirm the price with the retailer.
- Please cite as "Strikethrough (strikethrough.com.au)" and include the date checked.
